link.aiHint: The AI watches the whole video like an upload: Whisper transcribes the full audio (Claude can't hear audio), then the AI you pick — Claude by default — checks it against frames from the entire video and edits names, numbers and punctuation. Silent videos are described from the frames.

origin.framesDescribed: The video has no real speech: the AI wrote the script from frames across the whole video. Review before analyzing.

layerHint.scene: A whole frame of the scene — the subject stays still, drawn together with the background.
layerHint.cutout: The subject alone on a transparent background — composited onto the frame and animated in editing (e.g. a phone lighting up, a character waving). Cropped tight to the subject on import.

batchPrompt.layerAuto: AI picks when writing the prompt
batchPrompt.packFrame: {ratio} frame · {cutouts, plural, one {# transparent PNG} other {# transparent PNGs}}
batchPrompt.useOriginalHint: This image was cropped tight automatically. If the crop cut into the subject, click to use the uncropped original.
batchPrompt.rewriteAllDescription: The AI rewrites the {count} prompts in this scene range with the latest rules, replacing the old ones — {count} Claude calls. Layers you picked by hand are kept.
batchPrompt.layersHint: The AI works like a director: it breaks each scene into shots (establishing, insert, reaction close-up, over-the-shoulder, to-camera…) following the editing skill, then lists the images each shot needs — background, PNGs, a sprite sheet per action beat — drawn for that shot's framing. How many shots and images depends on each scene's script.

batchPrompt.splitConfirmTitle: Plan shots & layers for this scene range?

The result is saved as a new (approved) script version. Picks of the scenes that change are cleared.
batchPrompt.promptsNeedLayers: These scenes haven't been planned into shots & layers (②) yet — their images have no shot, layer or position/angle, so prompts written now lack that and will need rewriting. Do step ② first.

training.title: AI training
training.metaDescription: Train skills from many videos and documents, with a version per training run.
training.intro: Teach the AI a voice and style by letting it read many videos and documents together — from links, uploaded videos or documents, just like the Script step. It keeps what they share (the author's real voice) plus the rules and knowledge in your documents, and writes a complete skill. Every training run is saved as a version you can review or restore.

A graphics skill learns from many example images to keep generated images visually consistent in the Assets step.
